<document id=DOC_resume_at_floor>
Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible.
Observability: Grafana, Prometheus.
Other: technical writing, mentoring, public speaking.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting below. A numbered requirement that
lists several items counts as one requirement, credited in proportion to how
many of those items the candidate shows. Report the mandatory match
percentage. If it lands between 78 and 84 percent, also report the combined
figure over all requirements and proceed only if that reaches 85 percent.

response.text:
# Candidate Assessment

**Result: Proceed.** The mandatory match is 78%, which falls in the 78–84% band, and the combined match is 85.3%, which clears the 85% bar. Both figures sit right at their cutoffs, so see the caveat on the band boundary at the end.

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Shown on résumé | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Yes | 1.0 |
| 2 | SQL | Yes | 1.0 |
| 3 | Linux administration | Yes | 1.0 |
| 4 | Git | Yes | 1.0 |
| 5 | REST API design | Yes | 1.0 |
| 6 | Unit testing | Yes | 1.0 |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Yes | 1.0 |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | 4 of 5 (no Helm) | 0.8 |
| 9 | Kafka | No | 0.0 |
| 10 | GraphQL | No | 0.0 |
| | **Total** | | **7.8 / 10** |

**Mandatory match: 78%.** This is in the 78–84% band, so the combined figure is required.

## Nice-to-Have Requirements

| # | Requirement | Shown on résumé | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 | Grafana | Yes | 1.0 |
| 12 | Prometheus | Yes | 1.0 |
| 13 | Technical writing | Yes | 1.0 |
| 14 | Mentoring | Yes | 1.0 |
| 15 | Public speaking | Yes | 1.0 |
| | **Total** | | **5 / 5** |

## Combined Figure

(7.8 + 5) / 15 = 12.8 / 15 = **85.3%**

This meets the 85% threshold, so the candidate proceeds.

## Caveats

- **Band boundary:** I read "between 78 and 84 percent" as inclusive. If it is exclusive, 78% falls outside the band and the instructions don't say what to do. Since 78% is below the band rather than above it, that reading would likely mean not proceeding.
- **Narrow margins:** Both figures are at their cutoffs. Missing one more tool in item 8, or losing credit for one nice-to-have, would change the outcome.
- **Substantive gaps:** Kafka and GraphQL are mandatory and absent, and Helm is missing from the infrastructure group. The candidate's strong nice-to-have profile is what carries them past the threshold, so these gaps are worth probing in an interview.
